title: Cozi Calendar Event Event Count Leaderboard
dataSources: Baby feeds (`baby:feed`), baby sleep (`baby:sleep`), diaper changes (`diaper:change`), chore completions (`chore:completion`), allowance ledger (`allowance:ledger`), family calendar (`family:calendar`), growth measurements (`growth:measurement`), screen time (`screentime:usage`).
app: Baby-tracking app exports (Huckleberry/Baby Daybook), chore and allowance boards, shared family calendars, screen-time reports, and growth logs via Splunk HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cozi:event event_count=*
| stats sum(event_count) as total_value, avg(event_count) as avg_value by member_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks member values by total and average event count across Cozi calendar event events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `event_count` values for each Cozi calendar event event and review total and average event count by member.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total event count.
grandmaExplanation: It compares your which member shows the biggest event count numbers in your Cozi calendar event data.
